---
title: "Decision flowcharts"
---

The two flowcharts summarize the guiding questions and the options at each stage for the two designs covered in the hands-on session. They are Figures 3.2 and 3.3 of the handbook, and Chapter 3 discusses each decision. The guidance for the multisite cluster assignment design combines the two.

During the exercise block, find your design, answer the questions for your own study, and note which option you choose at each stage. Each option corresponds to a block of code on the Chapter 5, 6, or 7 page.
